title: File:Rice terraces in Sapa, Vietnam.jpg
claims: The photograph looks across terraced fields in the Muong Hoa valley near Sa Pa, with dry-season paddies and paths in the foreground and middle ground, forested slopes on both sides and the town of Sa Pa as a pale strip on the distant ridge; it is a valley landscape, not a marked race line, a checkpoint, an aid station or a race-day scene.

Commons titles the file Rice terraces in Sapa, Vietnam.jpg and the description reads 'Rice terraces in Sapa, Vietnam'; the route page uses it as landscape context for the Muong Hoa valley section described by the organiser, not as a survey of the 2026 course.

The author is Eerin25; the file is licensed CC0 1.0; the photograph was taken on 2019-12-16 at 14:11:21; the original is 4,272 x 2,848 pixels and 4,084,598 bytes; the file page gives no camera coordinates.
The route page uses a 960 x 640 copy of 302,629 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits Eerin25, CC0 1.0, Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same public-domain dedication.
